record.reason: The paper treats CoT as serial computation and tests when Transformers cannot solve tasks without it, including MATH-500/AIME; erasing chains hurts serial-task accuracy. Relevant to reasoning-token cost decisions, but establishes limits rather than a resource-reduction method.
record.title: Ceiling of a Task: When Can a Transformer Succeed Without Its Chain of Thought?
